title: Register as an employer before taking on apprentices or trainees
what: Enter into a training contract (an apprenticeship or traineeship) only as a registered employer, within the scope of that registration.

sources.title: South Australian Skills Act 2008 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An employer must not enter into a training contract to train a person unless the employer is— (a) a registered employer; and (b) operating within the scope of the registration of the employer
